# 1662. Check If Two String Arrays are Equivalent

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def arrayStringsAreEqual(self, word1, word2):
        """
        :type word1: List[str]
        :type word2: List[str]
        :rtype: bool
        """
        return "".join(word1) == "".join(word2)
```
